title: Lamborghini Urus vs Ferrari Purosangue: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two Italian SUVs, two completely different engines. The Lamborghini Urus has a four litre twin-turbo V eight. The Ferrari Purosangue has a six point five litre V twelve with no turbochargers, that revs to eight thousand two hundred fifty. One has more torque, and the other has more power. One costs, by our own arithmetic, about one hundred seventy thousand dollars less. And Ferrari insists that its car is not an SUV at all. This is the real difference between them. Here is the twist. The cheaper car has more torque, and gets it four thousand r p m earlier. The more expensive car is quicker to two hundred kilometres per hour, by more than two seconds. And Ferrari will build fewer Purosangue each year than Lamborghini builds Urus, by design. Let us go through the numbers, and the places where the sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
